title: Hiding Among the Baggage
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Then Samuel anointed young Saul,
"The Lord has chosen you."
He called the people all to come
And meet their new king too.

[Chorus]
When something feels too big for you,
You need not hide away.
Just say, "I'm willing," and the Lord
Will make you brave today.

[Verse 2]
But where was Saul? He'd gone to hide
Among the bags, so shy.
They found him, and he stood up tall,
"Long live the king!" they cry.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now rest, my brave and little one,
And let the day be done.
Heavenly Father stays right here
Until the morning sun.

[Chorus]
mood: Gathering music. A soft, expectant pulse moves under the voice, like a crowd waiting quietly and then a shy boy being coaxed to stand up tall. The first verses hold a gentle rise, a little hush, then a warm lift when Saul is found and the people cheer. By the last verse the pulse slows and lowers, the bigness of the day melting into a calm, small, safe place to sleep.
